about:
Arizona Foods Group Inc. operates a production facility in Phoenix, Arizona. The company is a third-generation family-owned and operated food manufacturing business that has served the food service industry for over 85 years.

The company manufactures a range of food products for the food service sector, including frozen yogurt and other items, and operates an extensive private label program that allows customers to market products under their own brands. Details on facility size, employee count, or annual volumes are not publicly provided.

The company serves food service operators, distributors, and other businesses across the United States. Membership in UniPro Foodservice and All Star Purchasing connects it to large purchasing cooperatives in the industry.

The company states that it is committed to total excellence whether producing under its own label or through its private label program, which it promotes as a means for clients to gain a competitive edge by offering high-quality products under their own brands.
